segments.description: Produces sheet, plate, structural and bar steel from recycled scrap in electric arc furnaces, selling mainly to steel service centers, fabricators and manufacturers in North America.
segments.evidence: In the steel mills segment, Nucor produces sheet steel (hot-rolled, cold-rolled and galvanized), plate steel, structural steel (wide-flange beams, beam blanks, H-piling and sheet piling) and bar steel (blooms, billets, concrete reinforcing bar, merchant bar and engineered special bar quality ("SBQ")).

segments.description: Produces and procures ferrous and non-ferrous materials, including DRI and scrap processed through DJJ, primarily supplying Nucor's steel mills.
segments.evidence: The Company also produces and procures ferrous and non-ferrous materials primarily for use in its steel manufacturing business.

revenueModel.text: Nucor earns revenue by selling steel and steel products to external customers such as steel service centers, fabricators and manufacturers, largely through contract and spot sales.
revenueModel.evidence: The steel mills segment sells its products primarily to steel service centers, fabricators and manufacturers located throughout the United States, Canada and Mexico.
